premise: Seal wonders whether big Pelican can swim; he sits down on the water and floats like a cork, because his feathers and even his bones are full of air.
inspiration: The 'can you…?' dare of folk tales (the animal who is doubted) answered calmly: he just shows her, and the two best floaters bob together.
learning: Pelicans float on the water like corks, because they are full of air.

en-US.title: Pelican Floats
en-US.text: {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Pelican stood on the rocks, looking at the water. {pelican:live} He scooped up a beakful, and gulped. {seal:enter by swim} Seal popped up below. {seal:wobble} [curious] Pelican, can you swim? {pelican:face happy} Pelican smiled. Watch, he said. {pelican:go to sea by float} Down he flapped, and sat on the water, light as a feather. He bobbed. He floated. He didn't sink one bit. {seal:hop} [in awe] How do you DO that? asked Seal. {pelican:float loop 0.3} My feathers are full of air, said Pelican. Even my bones have air inside. So I float like a cork! {ring:enter} {ring:go to sea} Just then the rubber ring came bobbing past. {ring:live} It turned slowly round. [laughs] Look! said Seal. {seal:spin} You float just like the ring! {pelican:hearts} {ring:pulse} [softly] And there they bobbed, side by side, Pelican and the ring, the two best floaters around.

es-ES.title: Pelícano flota
es-ES.text: {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Pelícano estaba en las rocas, mirando el agua. {pelican:live} Recogió un buen trago con el pico, y se lo tragó. {seal:enter by swim} Foca asomó por debajo. {seal:wobble} [curious] Pelícano, ¿tú sabes nadar? {pelican:face happy} Pelícano sonrió. Mira, dijo. {pelican:go to sea by float} Bajó aleteando, y se sentó en el agua, ligero como una pluma. Se mecía. Flotaba. No se hundía ni un poquito. {seal:hop} [in awe] ¿Cómo lo HACES?, preguntó Foca. {pelican:float loop 0.3} Mis plumas están llenas de aire, dijo Pelícano. Hasta mis huesos tienen aire dentro. ¡Por eso floto como un corcho! {ring:enter} {ring:go to sea} En ese momento pasó el flotador, meciéndose. {ring:live} Giró despacito. [laughs] ¡Mira!, dijo Foca. {seal:spin} ¡Flotas igual que el flotador! {pelican:hearts} {ring:pulse} [softly] Y allí se quedaron, meciéndose uno al lado del otro, Pelícano y el flotador, los mejores flotadores de por aquí.
